bullets.text: X Rolls Out Account Transparency - **X** introduces a feature to enhance user authenticity by displaying account details.
Apple Wallet's Digital ID Launch - **Apple** enhances Wallet with a Digital ID feature, streamlining identification processes.
Apple Maps Gets AI Upgrade - **Apple Maps** now features natural language search, improving user experience significantly.
WhatsApp Revives Status Updates - **WhatsApp** launches an 'About' feature, reminiscent of early status updates for users.
ChatGPT Introduces Group Chats - **OpenAI** expands **ChatGPT** capabilities with group chat features for enhanced interaction.
London Thieves Prefer iPhones - Thieves in London are increasingly returning non-iPhone devices to their owners.
CrowdStrike Fires Insider - **CrowdStrike** terminates an employee linked to a data leak to hackers.
Google Confirms Data Theft - **Google** reveals hackers stole data from over 200 companies via a **Salesforce** breach.
FCC Scraps Cybersecurity Rules - The **FCC** votes to eliminate cybersecurity regulations despite recent hacking incidents.
SpaceX's Starship Testing Mishap - **SpaceX** experiences an explosion during testing of its upgraded Starship rocket.
